description: Per-feature constraint registry. direction: -1 protective, +1 risk-increasing, 0 unconstrained. immutable: recourse may not move the feature. step_fraction: the largest fraction of the feature's observed range a single recourse plan may move it by, null where the feature is immutable.

RevolvingUtilizationOfUnsecuredLines.justification: +1: high revolving utilisation is the single strongest sub-score input in FICO and directly risk-increasing.

age.justification: -1: older applicants have longer, more stable credit histories and lower observed default rates in every large credit dataset.

NumberOfTime30-59DaysPastDueNotWorse.justification: +1: any past-due count is a direct risk signal by definition.

DebtRatio.justification: +1: higher debt-to-income reduces capacity to service further debt and is a canonical default predictor.

MonthlyIncome.justification: -1: higher income raises debt-service capacity; treated as protective (parallel to HELOC's ExternalRiskEstimate direction).

NumberOfOpenCreditLinesAndLoans.justification: 0: mix of protective (access) and risk-increasing (exposure) — leave the sign to the data rather than force a direction.

NumberOfTimes90DaysLate.justification: +1: severe (90+ day) delinquency is the strongest default-history signal in this feature set.

NumberRealEstateLoansOrLines.justification: 0: mortgages are secured (reducing risk) but multiple can indicate over-extension — direction is genuinely ambiguous.

NumberOfTime60-89DaysPastDueNotWorse.justification: +1: intermediate-severity delinquency, directionally identical to the 30-59 and 90+ counts.

NumberOfDependents.justification: +1: more dependents raise fixed household expenditure and narrow the income buffer available for debt service.
